Chocolate isn't poisonous like most people think. Its just causes diarrhea. The health threat comes from dehydration (which is general worry as some people don't allow their dogs unlimited access to water in the first place) and malnourishment if the diarrhea persists for too long.

Obviously smaller dogs take less chocolate to have a stronger reaction. A giant breed dog might be able to eat a whole chocolate bar and barely have a loose stool, depending on the animal.

Came here to say this. A long time ago when my sister was mad at my dog for almost eating a three year old girl, she gave him a whole bunch of chocolate and nothing happened. She was very disappointed.

It is caffeine poisoning and as you said the smaller the dog the less it takes, but it is absolutely poisoning it jsut takes much more than people generally think per weight.

A large breed like a huskey would be able to eat a fair amount of chocolate and likely only have digestion issues leading to dehydration and over heating. Caffeine also causes dogs and cats to become hyperactive just like people, furthering the dehydration and overheating.
Moral of the story, don't feed them chocolate and always allow them to have access to water.

Hey guys! Getting back on the saddle and hoping for a good community of Vapers here on Voat to join and become a part of.

I started vaping about 2 and a half years ago and haven't looked back since. Gone through a modest amount of gear over that time (I'm not one to just buy things new and shiny all the time haha) and have really prided myself on being the advocate for the new guy (Newbie) and really spending my efforts helping to convert as many as I can with a non confrontational non pushy approach. I really just want to help the community in any way I can, and help people get off those nasty stinkies.

That being said, I'd like to try something I started a long time ago, with mod permission, and community support. I want to do a weekly (at least) thread for New vapers and veterans alike for questions that need answering.

What setup do I get? How much am I going to (should I) spend? Why is my tank doing this? How come it's so harsh?

I really want to throw myself into this head first, and I hope the community has input, advice, and supports the cause. I am not looking to do this alone, so a weekly google hangout would be cool as well. What do you guys think?

TL:DR - I want to help the community here on Voat, start a Newbie thread once a week at least, maybe a google hangout. Input and suggestions wanted and appreciated.

 

In the mean time, I created this website that I've been updating and would love input on that too. Design, content, the works. No criticism too small.

How to start Vaping, How to get rid of those nasty cancer sticks, rebuilding, tutorials, and anything else you can think of! I will be updating it CONSTANTLY as new information comes in or I have an idea of how to expand. Thank you guys SO much and check it out, forward it to your friends, family, and anyone else that is looking to get into Vaping.

Http://VapeUniversity.Org

P.S. Check out my tutorial and youtube channel if you haven't already. It's going to be active with vlogs and all sorts of stuff in the coming weeks.
